courtsReady.text:
Good News, Wishing Well Tennis Club Members! 🎾

Our courts are almost finished! The final lines were painted today and need two days to harden. To make sure everything cures properly, the City has placed chains and padlocks on the gates so no one can get onto the courts before they are ready.

The good news is—we are opening this Friday, August 21st at 8:00 AM! 🎉

tournament.text:
Club Year-End Tennis Tournament — September 5th & 6th, 2026 🎾

All Wishing Well members are invited to join the club tournament on Sept 5 and 6 (Sat–Sun), 9 AM – 6 PM each day, with Open Singles, Ladies Singles, and Open Doubles categories.

To enter, email mahakwwtournamentdirector@gmail.com with your name, phone number, and categories by Monday, August 31st, 2026. Please be available both days.
